name: section-testimonials
title: Testimonials Section
description: Testimonials section in three layouts (grid, centered, wall) that takes its colours, fonts and radius from the project's design system

layouts.title: Grid
layouts.description: Quote cards in one, two or three columns as the width grows; the default.

layouts.title: Centred
layouts.description: One large quote per row, centred, the portrait and name below it.
layouts.usage: <TestimonialsSection layout="centered" content={{ title, items: [{ quote, name, role, image }] }} />

layouts.title: Wall
layouts.description: Quote cards of their own heights in flowing columns, for many quotes of different lengths.

proof: installs alone on Next 16; layouts grid, centered, wall; default look equals 2.0.0; 3 sample brands, light and dark, at 390/768/1280 px in two host apps; axe clean; no colour, font or radius leak
postMessage: See components/section-testimonials/README.md for the layouts, the design tokens it reads and the content props.
